1.explanation:
• extensions/revealjs/simple/preso.qmd and extensions/revealjs/bundle/preso.qmd provide the core HTML/CSS templates for revealjs presentations, including how slides are wrapped and how hash fragments are applied (number vs. title). 
• doc-layout/title-block.qmd shows how Quarto renders and positions the title block (title, subtitle, author, date) on the page — this is what shifts when the hash-type is changed.  
• reveal/index.qmd is the user-facing demo of a reveal presentation; it illustrates how the format defaults and can be configured (e.g. setting hash-type) and serves as a minimal repro for the slide alignment issue.
1.bug_scenario: When using “hash-type: number” in a revealjs Quarto presentation the title slide elements (title, subtitle, author and date) are all shifted to the left edge instead of being centered. The two screenshots show (1) the broken version: the title block (Test, Test, Test, 2/18/23) aligns flush left, and (2) the working version using “hash-type: title” where the same title block is properly centered. The key elements involved are the revealjs slide container, the title block markup (Quarto’s title-block layout), and the CSS/HTML template that wraps slides in numbered hash fragments.
